then.say: Eh? Oh. Sit, sit, if your legs'll let you. Mine won't. Jost. Pilgrim, once.
See the shell on my coat? You get that at the sea shrine. You get the candle up there. I got the shell.
Through the Gatehouse to the east, then up. The Tollwarden takes a toll. It isn't coin.

else.say: The Gatehouse is open, they tell me. I'd go myself if the hill were half as tall.

do.say: When I was young it was a promise. You walked to it and it forgave you. Didn't matter what for.
Now it's a smell. A smell of fat and a bell ringing. Forgive me for saying so.
Walk careful. The road remembers feet.
